shell.disclaimer: Projections are estimates from public data. You stay in charge: Adept never makes hiring decisions.

auth.forTeamBody: See team gaps and plan training

auth.consent: I understand Adept stores my profile to give me suggestions, and that career projections are estimates, not guarantees.
auth.artTitle: From who you are today to where you can be.

auth.artTeamTitle: Grow your team for the AI era.
auth.artTeamBody: See where your people stand, plan training together and track progress.

landing.title: Know which skills the AI era needs. Build them.
landing.body: Adept tracks AI research and job-market signals, matches you to future roles and builds a step-by-step learning plan linked to the UN Goals.
landing.step1Body: Upload a CV or pick from 110+ skills.
landing.step2Body: See what is rising and declining, with sources.
landing.step3Body: Ranked matches with a clear skills gap.
landing.step4Body: Free and HRD Corp-claimable courses, in order.
landing.sub: Upload your CV. In seconds you see which of your skills are rising, and the future role that fits you best.
landing.dropBody: PDF or text, up to 5 MB. Read in memory and never stored.
landing.consentCv: I agree Adept may read this CV to show my results. It is not saved.
landing.safe: Your CV is not stored or shared
landing.errorType: Use a PDF or plain-text file under 5 MB.
landing.errorConsent: Please tick the box so we can read your CV.
landing.errorGeneric: We couldn’t read that file. Please try another.
landing.found: {count, plural, =0 {No skills found} one {# skill found} other {# skills found}}
landing.noneFound: We couldn’t match skills in this file. Try a text-based PDF, or sign up and pick your skills.
landing.trendTitle: Your skills in the AI era
landing.lockedBody: Create a free account to unlock {count, plural, one {# more role} other {# more roles}}, your exact skills gap, a step-by-step learning plan and the UN Goals your path supports.
landing.estimate: Estimates from public data, as of {date}
landing.tSub: Share one join code. Your people add their skills in minutes, and you see the gaps against rising roles and one training plan for everyone.
landing.tStep1Body: No email lists. People sign up and enter your code.
landing.tStep2Body: Each person uploads a CV or picks skills; you see who is done.
landing.tStep3Body: Which skills your team lacks for each future role, at a glance.
landing.tStep4Body: Ordered courses, HRD Corp-claimable where possible, with SDG impact.
landing.tPrivacy: Members see their own data; managers see team summaries. Adept never makes hiring decisions.
